rows.en: <operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Never thought the <color(5)>Siberian Railway<ce()> would chase us all the way out here...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Isn't the <color(5)>Siberian Railway<ce()> supposed to be a Domepolis police force?
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Their pride got wounded, so they're getting worked up over it. Not that we've got time to deal with them.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Oh right, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, how's that game... 'Overman Battle' going for you lately?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I've been going out on sorties so much lately, I haven't had time to play.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>While the King's been away from the game, a new champ was born, huh.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, there's a player who racked up 200 straight wins, same as me, and earned the title of 'Queen.'
rows.notes: 'Overman Battle' is an in-universe game name with no match in the King Gainer wiki or project glossary; treated as ACE3-original hangar banter and translated literally. 'King'/'Queen' are the game's rank titles, kept as plain English words rather than proper nouns.

rows.en: <operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Hey... you two! Save the game talk for after we're back from combat! This isn't playtime, don't let your guard down!
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, what's wrong? You look like you're deep in thought.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I was a little surprised <color(4)>Jamil<ce()> had a past like that.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Even simply saying 'fighting' in one breath, everyone's carrying their own reasons for it, huh.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Made me realize how little I actually know.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>If you're starting to realize that, it means you've grown a little too.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Do you have something like that too, <color(4)>Faye<ce()>?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>That's a story for when we've got more time to spare.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Amuro<ce()>, is something wrong?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>...Just remembering the whole thing with <color(6)>Lucille<ce()>. There was someone I couldn't save either...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I was wondering if tragedy is simply something that follows <color(4)>Newtypes<ce()> around.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>T-that's not true!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah! The future's something you carve out with your own strength!
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Heh... yeah, you're right... Guess I ended up being the one getting encouraged.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>You two make sure you protect <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> and <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, no matter what.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Y-yes!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>. I want power.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>So that what happened to <color(6)>Lucille<ce()> never happens again.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>And... I want to protect you.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I believe in you too, <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Enemy's inbound and here they are, taking it easy.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>But <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>'s piloting, honed on that game, is actually pretty impressive.
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>Right, right, the guy's got the skill and the track record, so don't get on his case.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>What's wrong with that... merely talking about a game.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>I like you better in the <color(4)>King Gainer<ce()>'s cockpit - feels more human.
rows.notes: 'King Gainer' here is the locked mecha name; distinct from the earlier bare 'King' (Gainer's personal gaming title, text_id 25) despite sharing the word in Japanese.

rows.en: <operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>What's that supposed to mean?
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Get out a little, learn a few things. Can't live on games alone, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> is right in front of us...
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>The Getter Ray density is climbing, little by little.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>This time, I'll settle this for good...!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Deal with the enemy in front of you first.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>I know that without you telling me!
